prompt: The same scene, one continuous real-time shot from the locked-off elevated three-quarter camera. Slotted brass weights are placed one at a time onto the peg of the small platform at the top of the upright thin steel strip, about one every second. The strip stays perfectly straight under the first several weights, then, as one more weight is added, it suddenly bows sideways into a single smooth arc and holds that bent shape while more weights are added, bending a little further each time. The vise and workbench never move. Warm cinematic workshop light. No cuts, no camera movement, no slow motion, no text.
